title: Bolus progress bar does not update if display goes to sleep
body:
Pixel 6a, Android 16, Omnipod Dash.

Since updating to v3.4.2.3 I have noticed the following new odd behaviour:

When delivering a bolus, if the display goes to sleep during the bolus, the progress bar does not update. The bolus is delivered correctly and a 'bolus delivered' sound plays on the Dash pod. When the display is opened, the progress bar is however stuck on zero bolus delivered, forcing me to press the stop bolus button. This clears the progress bar and if I check the Treatments page, the correct bolus delivered is shown. Therefore it feels like it is purely a progress bar update issue. Is this known issue?
